focused_command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_signed_phase_review.py tests/test_approval_security.py tests/test_signed_phase_review_interfaces.py tests/test_signed_full_workflow.py

negative_controls.scenario: An earlier author republishes the same phase item through another actor, then submits a signed review as independent.
negative_controls.observed: The challenge API refuses the author; a directly appended signed review is visible but ineffective during replay.

negative_controls.scenario: The first verified normative approval is revoked and a second actor approves the same item version after critique was reviewed and advanced.
negative_controls.observed: The old snapshot, review and advance become ineffective; a new review and advance restore acceptance.

negative_controls.scenario: A later invalid approval and an unrelated normative approval are appended.
negative_controls.observed: The last verified approval remains effective and an unrelated earlier phase stays accepted.

review_scope: An independent read-only reviewer reproduced both original bypasses on the prior code and could not reproduce them after the fix; later invalid approval and unrelated-approval controls were also checked.
limitations: The cases, keys and actors in the regression are synthetic.
Ledger hashes alone do not protect event history from a writer who can replace the ledger and its external trust material together.
The fix does not authenticate the competence, personal independence or substantive judgment of a reviewer.
